- Section A (Security Policy & Governance) — Marissa Cole (Policy + compliance artifacts; will pull SOC 2 control list)
- Section D (Infrastructure & Network) — Dev Patel (Network diagrams, VPC configs, firewall rules, DR runbooks)
- Section K (Identity & Access Management) — Aditya Rao (IAM inventories, SSO configuration, user access review logs)

Operational notes / asks:
- Evidence placement: please upload artifacts to the shared drive folder (Drive link below) and add a short evidence-index.md mapping file with file names and brief descriptions.
- For logs (access / audit), point me to where we can generate short exports; if any exports require SRE approval, flag them now.
- Attachments: I attached SIG_section_grid.xlsx — populate the "owner" and "evidence_link" columns by EOD Friday (6/11).

Drive link (internal): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cSIGShared/overview
Priority: High — Jared's procurement timeline is tight (they're coordinating with their legal team).

If you disagree with any assignment, propose an alternate owner and brief rationale.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SIG_section_grid.xlsx (blank grid to assign owners)
